g.text: What Remit flagged, and when it acts.
Moved 112 · Warned 64 · You marked Not spam 3
Opening a row opens the message in its label list, where Not spam rescues it.
Scores run from 0 to 1. The deployment default is 0.40 and 0.85.
These values apply to mail arriving from now on.
Check again in a label list updates older mail.
Warn only keeps the message where it arrived, under the warning banner.
Their mail skips the spam check.
Their mail goes straight to Junk.
